summary: Iter273: tested International Texting, USA Texting Number, hosted SMS off, Bird number lookup, paid extra SIP logins, AI receptionist on any plan, the 10DLC no-US-numbers guard, and the plan ladder regression. Backend: 24 pytest checks (2 files), 22 passed. Two real problems: (1) Infobip PL/LT/ES numbers are saved with capabilities.voice=true after purchase. (2) MultiTEL login is refused (401), so GB/BR/CA/CO/DK/NL/PE searches come back empty with no error. Frontend: every requested page and flow works, but the landing page still sells 'Landline to Texting' ($99 to start, 'Start texting' button) even though hosted SMS is turned off.

critical.issue: The saved number always gets capabilities.voice=true. js/cloudivr-web/numbers.js ~line 445 hard-codes `const caps = { voice: true, sms: ..., mms: ..., fax: ... }` and ignores hit.capabilities.voice. A dry-run PL Infobip purchase (search said voice:false) was stored with {voice:true,sms:true}, so SMS-only LT/PL/ES numbers claim they take calls. The same hard-coding is in the replace-number path at ~line 887. Fix: voice: hit.capabilities.voice !== false.

MultiTEL refuses the login ('[Multitel] search GB mobile: MultiTEL login was rejected — check the API username/password and IP allow-list'; '[Multitel] inventory: MultiTEL auth refused (401)'). The route returns 200 with numbers:[] and the UI says 'No numbers free right now', which hides the real cause. So BR/CA/CO/DK/NL/PE/GB can't be bought in preview. The background inventory job has also logged 27 rejected logins. That risks the MultiTEL blocklist the user warned about; add a backoff / circuit breaker after an auth failure.

minor.issue: The review request says POST, but the route is PUT. Tested with PUT: Bob gets 400 no_us_numbers and his wallet is not debited.
Removing a paid login gives no refund or pro-rating, and adding it back charges $5 again. This may be intended, but the remove dialog doesn't say the $5 is lost.

ui_bugs.component: Landing page (PricingFaq TextingCard, Platform 'hosted' panel, products menu, UseCases 'New · Landline to Texting')
ui_bugs.issue: The landing page still sells Landline to Texting ($99 to start, then $29/month, 'Start texting' button visible on the business-line pricing tab), but hosted SMS is unavailable (available:false, POST refused).

integration_issues.flow: International Texting -> pick a MultiTEL country (GB)
integration_issues.issue: Because the MultiTEL login fails, the page shows 'No numbers free right now. Try again in a few minutes.' instead of a provider error.

issues: nav-texting label 'Add texting to a landline…' is cut off, so its 'Soon' pill can't be seen (inner text has 'Soon', but it's hidden by the ellipsis).

The buy-line-section subtitle says 'pick Pro or Business: those plans include SIP logins', but Starter ($75) now includes SIP too (the SIP purpose card says 'Comes with the Starter, Pro and Business plans').
It doesn't mention unlimited texts or the 11 international texting countries, unlike the in-app Texting Number page and the SMS purpose card.

action_items: numbers.js checkout/extra (~line 445) and replace (~line 887): use the provider's voice capability instead of hard-coded voice:true, so LT/PL/ES numbers are saved as SMS-only

MultiTEL: fix the credentials / IP allow-list in preview, and stop the inventory job retrying after a 401 (blocklist risk); search should return an error (e.g. 424 provider_unavailable) instead of an empty list
Landing: remove or mark 'coming soon' the Landline to Texting card, the Platform 'hosted' panel, the menu item and the use case (no 'Start texting' button while HS.AVAILABLE is false)
Sidebar: make the 'Soon' pill on nav-texting visible (shorten the label or stop the pill truncating)
BuyNumber buy-line-section subtitle: say Starter, Pro or Business include SIP
critical_code_review_comments: numbers.js /texting/ready returns plan:'starter' with price from plans.starter (internal key for Basic, $50). Correct, but easy to confuse with the 'Starter' display name ($75 = key 'standard').

lookup.js: the 'number-lookup' transaction id is `lookup-${chatId}-${Date.now()}`. Two parallel lookups in the same ms would hit a duplicate key after the debit, so the wallet is debited but the request fails with 500 and no refund. Use a uuid.
lookup.js charges even when Bird returns valid:false. That seems fine as a 'successful lookup', but say so in the UI copy.
numbers.js is 937 lines; consider splitting out the texting / extra-SIP routes.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows work; the landing hosted-SMS copy is inconsistent)

seed_data_creation: The intl-texting test file registers a fresh test_it273*@example.com TEST account, makes a dry-run PL purchase, then deletes its phoneNumbersOf/walletOf (the webAccount row stays). On Alice: accepted the policy gate in the UI; 2 real Bird lookups (+14155552671); 2 paid extra SIP logins added on +13346970101 and then removed ($5 each debited, not refunded; Alice's wallet is now ~$359.97). Added Business free logins and removed them again.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use ?tab=sip on /cloudivr/app/numbers/<enc phone> to reach the extra-sip-card. Alice has no legal profile ('Add details' banner), so real purchases from her account return 428; the PL purchase test uses a fresh TEST account. MultiTEL auth is failing in preview, so don't retry GB searches repeatedly. Bird lookups used this run: 2.
rca of the issue: PL voice=true: in numbers.js checkout, `const caps = { voice: true, sms: !!hit.capabilities.sms, ... }` overrides the searched capabilities, where Infobip PL has voice:false. Reproduce: search PL local texting=1, check out from a fresh account, then read phoneNumbersOf ... capabilities.voice = true. GB empty: MultiTEL returns 401 for the login, multitel.searchNumbers logs it and returns [], and the route returns numbers:[].
